watchlist_releases.name: v6.0.0
watchlist_releases.body:
## Overview

This release adds Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) for off-policy reinforcement learning. The implementation incorporates many ideas from [FlashSAC by Kim et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04539) and supports CUDA graph acceleration and distributed training. The release also separates optimization losses from diagnostic statistics in the algorithm and logging interfaces.

Custom algorithms, runners, and logging integrations require the adjustments described below.
